description: Build an unsigned Compound V3 withdraw transaction. Pass `amount: "max"` to withdraw the full supplied balance.

amount.description: Human-readable decimal amount of `asset`, NOT raw wei/base units. Example: "10" for 10 USDC. Pass "max" for full-balance withdraw.

market.description: Comet market address (e.g. cUSDCv3). Discover via get_compound_positions or the Compound registry.

name: prepare_compound_withdraw
